She called them her “glasses,” but they didn’t look to be made out of any glass that Alin had ever seen.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 7}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Grandmaster Naraka Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Grandmaster [[Naraka]] is an elderly woman and a powerful figure who serves as a mentor to [[Alin]] in [[Enosh]]. Rumored to be over a century old, she possesses a shriveled, hunched appearance and wears distinctive dark red lenses that may hide blindness. She is associated with the [[Territory]] of [[Naraka]], where she wears traditional dark red robes and can communicate mentally with its [[inhabitants]]. Her [[Authority|authority]] is significant enough that travelers within her domain fear her, and she maintains sentries to monitor movement. Throughout her history, [[Naraka]] has abandoned her original name and faced various hardships, including a scarred wrist and an arm that eventually transforms into a black, flaming claw. She holds strong views on the philosophy of [[Elysia]] and the nature of [[Incarnations]], expressing a preference for the virtue of [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] while criticizing the lack of conscience in the [[Elysian Incarnation]]. Despite her advanced age, she demonstrates a willingness to [[sacrifice]] her life to combat forces like [[Damasca]] and has been known to command guards during significant events.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This elderly woman possesses a gnarled face and straggly white hair. She wears thick, cracked red spectacles and has a single remaining hand, as the stump of her right arm was lost. Her physical form can transform into a hunched, serpentine shape featuring pale white eyes that turn orange, a spiked red pebbled tail, and elongated canine fangs.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A Grandmaster who betrayed [[the Queen]] of [[Damasca]], she remains composed even while staring through a gate. She does not protest when a prisoner is punished and maintains that the [[Incarnations]] are free. She claims to have shed her former self to serve as an avatar of her [[Territory]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Grandmaster [[Naraka]] serves as a teacher to [[Alin]]. She is also accompanied by [[Eliadel]] and has an unnamed granddaughter who was a [[Naraka Traveler]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As an [[Asphodel]] mist-binder, she can produce red fireflies from her hands and contact the denizens of [[Naraka]] mentally. She is capable of summoning a jet-black crocodile head on a long, serpentine neck. Additionally, her right hand manifests as a shriveled black claw covered in orange flame.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Presence in City of Light}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Grandmaster [[Naraka]] was accompanied by [[Eliadel]] during her time in the city.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c2">''City of Light'', chapter 2</ref> An elderly woman characterized by straggly white hair and cracked red spectacles, she is also a one-handed individual who bears a [[Naraka Traveler]]'s brand upon her palm.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4">''City of Light'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c9">''City of Light'', chapter 9</ref> She provided the necessary descriptions to facilitate the drawing of a map of [[Enosh]], a location where she had been on a mission.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c7">''City of Light'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17">''City of Light'', chapter 17</ref> While the mere thought of her blackens [[Alin]]'s mind, she remains in control of herself while staring at him through the [[Naraka Gate]] from her position beyond the Gate on red stones.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10">''City of Light'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c11">''City of Light'', chapter 11</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Prisoner in the camp}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|While held within the camp, Grandmaster [[Naraka]] remains bound, gagged, and under guard.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref> She offered no protest when [[Leah]] issued an order to punish a prisoner.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref> Having betrayed [[the Queen]] of [[Damasca]], she possesses a right hand that resembles a shriveled black claw covered in orange flame.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> During a transformation, her canines elongate into fangs as her body twists and stretches into a hunched, serpentine shape.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" /> This change also results in her pale white eyes turning the color of orange live coals and the appearance of a red, pebbled tail tipped with spikes.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|she always wore thick lenses over her eyes, colored a dark red. She called them her “glasses,” but they didn’t look to be made out of any glass that Alin had ever seen.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Grandmaster Naraka has sentries posted on the other side,” Gilad replied.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|"Allow me to tend to these two, Eliadel. I have some experience with Endross."<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“You see?” Grandmaster Naraka said. “It’s our victory. The Incarnations are free.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“I can contact the denizens of Naraka with my mind,” Grandmaster Naraka said.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" />}}
